data.name: Slim Flamingo Vs The 1%
data.detailed_description:
Slim Flamingo is a unique combination of a platformer and fps style shooter.  You platform infinity around a circular loop and fire your gun inwards towards the center at the boss.

There are no extra lives and every fight is a boss fight. 

Each of a dozen levels have their own obstacles, enemies, style and original soundtrack inspired by the greatest boss fights from the early 2000s.

Slim more than anything, is a flamingo, and more than that, wants to dismantle the hierarchy of hypocrisy and tear out the rotten rungs of the corporate ladder.

Full Finished Bosses :

  • Death Itself : A skull and spine that drifts up and down the center of the silo with guns of all types attached.  Later in the fight will summon ghost enemies who can phase through the platforms.

  • Test Tube 129 : A swimming level where you are in a test tube that is a massive microcosm of the ocean.  Swim through the volcanic depths to the tropical surface to defeat the giant brain at the top.

  • The Sin of Science : A glowing sphere that wears spinning geometric armor.  Chip away at the armor while dodge radial attacks.

Bosses In Production Now :

  • The When that Was : A clock face that moves time forwards or back whenever you shoot its clock hands.  You have to balance between the dangers of the past and the future.

  • Nostalgiant : A TV screen that can only take damage if you paint ever red pixel on the screen blue.  Challenging you to essentially draw while dodging dangers from all sides.

data.short_description: Platform infinity in a loop while shooting inwards at the boss in the center! With one health and only bosses inspired by the greatest boss fights for the 2000s, every moment is on edge, electric, do or die action!
